1292: InFlowBC_StaticProfile = BoundaryCondition:new()
1293: InFlowBC_StaticProfile.type = "inflow_static_profile"
1294: function InFlowBC_StaticProfile:new(o)
1295:    local flag = type(self)=='table' and self.type=='inflow_static_profile'
1296:    if not flag then
1297:       error("Make sure that you are using InFlowBC_StaticProfile:new{}"..
1298:                " and not InFlowBC_StaticProfile.new{}", 2)
1299:    end
1300:    o = o or {}
1301:    flag = checkAllowedNames(o, {"filename", "fileName", "match", "label", "group","field_bc"})
1302:    if not flag then
1303:       error("Invalid name for item supplied to InFlowBC_StaticProfile constructor.", 2)
1304:    end
1305:    o = BoundaryCondition.new(self, o)
1306:    o.is_wall_with_viscous_effects = false
1307:    o.match = o.match or "xyz-to-xyz"
1308:    o.filename = o.filename or o.fileName
1309:    o.preReconAction = { FlowStateCopyFromStaticProfile:new{filename=o.filename, match=o.match} }
1310:    o.preSpatialDerivActionAtBndryFaces = {
1311:       FlowStateCopyFromStaticProfileToInterface:new{filename=o.filename, match=o.match}
1312:    }
1313:    o.is_configured = true
1314:    return o
1315: end

1700: ExchangeBC_MappedCell = BoundaryCondition:new()
1701: ExchangeBC_MappedCell.type = "exchange_using_mapped_cells"
1702: function ExchangeBC_MappedCell:new(o)
1703:    local flag = type(self)=='table' and self.type=='exchange_using_mapped_cells'
1704:    if not flag then
1705:       error("Make sure that you are using ExchangeBC_MappedCell:new{}"..
1706:                " and not ExchangeBC_MappedCell.new{}", 2)
1707:    end
1708:    o = o or {}
1709:    flag = checkAllowedNames(o, {"cell_mapping_from_file", "fileName", "filename", "symmetric_mapping",
1710:                                 "transform_position", "c0", "n", "alpha", "delta",
1711:                                 "list_mapped_cells",
1712:                                 "reorient_vector_quantities", "Rmatrix",
1713:                                 "label", "group"})
1714:    if not flag then
1715:       error("Invalid name for item supplied to ExchangeBC_MappedCell constructor.", 2)
1716:    end
1717:    o = BoundaryCondition.new(self, o)
1718:    o.is_wall_with_viscous_effects = false
1719:    o.fileName = o.fileName or o.filename
1720:    o.preReconAction = { MappedCellCopy:new{cell_mapping_from_file=o.cell_mapping_from_file,
1721:                                            fileName=o.fileName,
1722:                                            symmetric_mapping=o.symmetric_mapping,
1723:                                            transform_position=o.transform_position,
1724:                                            c0=o.c0, n=o.n, alpha=o.alpha, delta=o.delta,
1725:                                            list_mapped_cells=o.list_mapped_cells,
1726:                                            reorient_vector_quantities=o.reorient_vector_quantities,
1727:                                            Rmatrix=o.Rmatrix} }
1728:    o.preSpatialDerivActionAtBndryFaces = { UpdateThermoTransCoeffs:new{thermoUpdate="global"} }
1729:    o.is_configured = true
1730:    return o
1731: end
